goal: Preserve available Codex and Claude JSONL session logs through an idempotent manual collector and restart-safe reconciliation without depending on session-end hooks.
in_scope: recursive source-root reconciliation API suitable for startup invocation
durable source cursor committed after artifacts
private verbatim and optional redacted transcript separation
machine-readable provenance and value-safe run result
fixture-based normal, negative, boundary, and interruption tests
out_of_scope: hook, watcher, scheduler, or service activation
acceptance: a repeated identical run writes no duplicate raw bytes or transcript events
an append advances raw and parsed offsets exactly once
a partial final JSONL line is preserved raw but not parsed until completed
a failure after artifact write and before cursor write is recoverable by rerun
source shortening or non-prefix mutation never overwrites the preserved raw
byte-exact raw, private verbatim, and redacted transcript have separate paths and digests
all three supported source kinds pass the same collector entry
startup-compatible reconciliation reports missing, diverged, failed, and successful sources without source content
private output roots inside the repository are rejected before writing
official full tests pass without fallback
stop_conditions: a private output may enter the repository or Git boundary
an unknown source would be guessed as a supported kind
a cursor would advance before durable raw and artifact verification
real private capture is reached without a fixed Human storage choice
recovery: preserve the last valid raw and cursor on write failure
rerun from the durable cursor after interruption
record divergence without overwriting the archive
regenerate derived artifacts from preserved raw
implementation_order: durable cursor and artifact commit ordering
